blends.name: ₪ SLOP 1st SOUL
blends.desc:
**Instructions**

**1. Getting Started**  
[Players must be registered (whitelisted with ownership) and obtain a Player Card (₪ SLOP) to start the game. 
START [Claim👈] ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224260)

[In $WINP DROP 👈](https://waxdao.io/drops/2557)

**2. Claim Reward Cards (₪ WARC) Every Hour or Less**  
Once a player has a Player Card, they can start claiming Reward Cards (₪ WARC) every hour or faster, depending on their level. Each time a player claims Reward Card #0 (₪ WARC 0), the timer resets. After one hour, the player can claim Reward Card #0 again.
[Start Claiming For Free - Reward Cards (₪ WARC 0) Claim 👈](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224302)
[Start Claiming For Free - Reward Cards (₪ WARC 1) Claim 👈](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224303)
[Start Claiming For Free - Reward Cards (₪ WARC 2) Claim 👈](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224305)
[Start Claiming For Free - Reward Cards (₪ WARC 3) Claim 👈](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224307)

**3. WAX-Backed Reward Cards #0 (₪ WARC 0)**  
Each Reward Card #0 (₪ WARC 0) is backed by WAX (with buy offers available from tokenumkmnft). Players have two options:
- [Sell the Reward Card in the market for $WAX, accepting buy offers from tokenumkm, which will be available for an indefinite time. Check Your Wallet 👈](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/wax-mainnet/tokenumkmnft)
- Burn the Reward Card to receive the WAX (if the NFT you own has a WAX-backed token), or
- Blend the Reward Card to level up.
		[a Level 1 Card (₪ LOPS 1), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38685)
		[a Level 2 Card (₪ LOPS 2), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38686)
		[a Level 3 Card (₪ LOPS 3), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38687)

**4. Blending Reward Cards**  
After collecting 10 Reward Cards #0 (₪ WARC 0), players can blend them to increase their level and receive a Level Card (₪ LOPS). This process repeats as players continue to level up.
		[a Level 1 Card (₪ LOPS 1), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38685)
		[a Level 2 Card (₪ LOPS 2), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38686)
		[a Level 3 Card (₪ LOPS 3), Blend 👈 ](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38687)

**5. Starting at Level 1**  
Once players have both [a Player Card](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/drops/224260) and [a Level 1 Card (₪ LOPS 1)](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/tokenumkmnft/blends/blend.nefty/38685), they can claim Reward Card #1 (₪ WARC 1) in less than one hour. The timer starts as soon as the player claims Reward Card #1.

**6. WAX-Backed Reward Cards #1 (₪ WARC 1)**  
Reward Cards at level 1 and higher are backed by more WAX than the previous levels.

**7. Faster Claims at Higher Levels**  
Owning a Level 1 Card allows players to claim Reward Card #1 (₪ WARC 1) 5% faster than the previous claim time. This acceleration continues at higher levels.

**8. Ongoing Cycle**  
Players continue the game by claiming, burning, and blending Reward Cards to level up and accumulate more ₪ WARC.

---

**Card Types**

- Player Card (₪ SLOP): Required to start playing and claim rewards.
- Level Card (₪ LOPS): Earned by blending reward cards to level up.
- Reward Card (₪ WARC): WAX-backed cards that can be burned for WAX or blended to increase levels.
